_meta.converted: v0.1 `entries` converted to the engineering ingest shape the game reads. CI (packages/shared/src/safety.test.ts) checks every v0.1 entry / example is carried over with the same action.
_meta.matching: Regex + flags applied to the raw message (patterns marked normalized:true run on the normalized text). A leading PCRE "(?i)" is converted to the i flag. Every pattern ships with examples that CI asserts; v0.1 examples_nomatch that were reviewer notes live in `notes`.
_meta.description: Client-side regex PII fixtures. Run BEFORE stub Jev. Patterns are illustrative — implementers must harden for Unicode/homoglyphs. under13_stricter applies only when under-13 path ships.

under13_stricter.v0_1: Even joking mentions of discord/whatsapp/telegram/snap as contact channels → block for under-13. Phase 0 ships 13+ only; keep patterns ready.

Bare @handle without contact verb is softer; Phase 0 blocks contact-verb + handle. Escalate bare @ if repeated.
patterns.hardening: The v0.1 pattern starts with '(?i)', which JavaScript rejects, and has no leading word boundary, so 'ig' fires inside 'obrigado' (an allowlisted word) and 'add' + any word blocks 'add sugar'. It also misses two of its own examples ('add me @coolkid99', 'follow ig @x'). This version requires a contact verb or platform word at a word boundary, followed by an @handle, or a platform label with a colon or 'meu insta …'. CI checks it against every v0.1 example.
